blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Aby Maraño may be signing off from playing, but her character as a fierce competitor left a big legacy in Philippine volleyball. Maraño, fondly known as ’Tyang Aby’, announced her retirement from professional volleyball on Wednesday. “I hope my legacy goes beyond the things I accomplished on the court. I hope people remember me as someone who gave everything she had to the sport, but also as someone who tried to use her platform to help other athletes and contribute to the growth of Philippine volleyball,” said Maraño in Filipino. “I also hope they remember me not just […]...
